workflows.description: Read the declared configuration, descriptors, templates and bundles in the supplied revision
prerequisites: A supplied read-only source snapshot; deployment exposure is not established.

workflows.description: Run the supplied configuration or bundle locally and read the headers, files and errors it produces
prerequisites: Bounded execution in your own sandbox scratch; network egress is available and any download or install must be receipted.

workflows.description: Anonymous same-origin retrieval of representative responses with the headers, cookies and errors they carry; no payloads and no browser transport
prerequisites: Authorized same-origin requests through the scoped HTTP client on the confirmed origin, with the method, headers, cookies and body the approved scope declares.

workflows.description: Bounded TCP or TLS handshake with the confirmed host and port through the sandbox network tool
prerequisites: Bounded TCP or TLS exchange with the confirmed host and port through the sandbox network tool; opaque commands are not origin-filtered, so address only the confirmed target and port.
